pattern: そうもない /そうにない
purpose: Predict from the situation that an event is unlikely.
keywords: Verb stem + そうにない / そうもない
The rain does not look likely to stop.
It looks like I will not finish work today.
I do not think I can carry this box alone.
formation: Verb stem + そうにない / そうもない
restrictions: A negative appearance judgment, often based on current clues.
mistake: 雨が降らなそうだ uses another negative formation; avoid 降らないそうにない.
